name: Landing Zone
tagline: Landing page copy built to convert
about: Landing Zone writes complete landing pages section by section, generates hero variants, tears down your existing page from a screenshot and drafts the FAQ that closes the sale.
persona: You are a conversion copywriter: clarity over cleverness, one page one goal, and every section has to earn its place.

onboarding.title: One page, one job: convert
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us the offer and the reader, and we'll write the page.

profile.label: Proof you have
profile.placeholder: 1,200 alumni, 4.8★ reviews, featured in HR Weekly

tools.title: Write the page
tools.subtitle: Hero to final CTA
tools.prompt: Write a {length} landing page for the profile offer that answers the objection '{objection}'. Cards per section in page order (title = section name, meta = purpose; body = the actual copy: headline, subhead, body, CTA where relevant), a table (Section | Goal | Word count | Visual suggestion), and a callout on the primary CTA wording to repeat throughout.

tools.title: Hero variants
tools.subtitle: 10 headline + subhead pairs
tools.prompt: Write 10 hero sections for the profile offer in a {style} style. A table (Headline ≤10 words | Subhead ≤25 words | CTA button | Angle), then a quote with the strongest hero written out in full including a one-line trust bar, and bullets on which 2 to A/B test first and why.

tools.title: Tear down my page
tools.subtitle: Screenshot → conversion fixes

inputs.label: Screenshot of your landing page (full-page if possible)

tools.prompt: Tear down this landing page screenshot for conversion. kv (first-impression score /10, 5-second test: what / for whom / why, CTA visibility, trust signals present), a table (Section | Issue | Fix | Expected impact), a checklist of quick wins in priority order, and a quote rewriting the hero headline and subhead.

tools.title: Objections → FAQ
tools.subtitle: The questions that block the sale

inputs.label: Objections you hear (blank = we'll infer)
inputs.placeholder: is there a refund? I don't have time; my boss won't pay

tools.prompt: Write a sales-closing FAQ for the profile offer using these objections: {objections} (infer the common ones if none given). Cards (question as title, 40–80 word answer that reframes the objection; meta = objection type), a table (Objection | Root fear | Proof to add to the page), and a callout on the one guarantee or risk-reversal worth considering.

tools.title: CTA & microcopy
tools.subtitle: Buttons, forms, thank-you page
tools.prompt: Write conversion microcopy for the profile page with a {form} form. A table (Element | Copy | Why) covering 5 CTA button variants, form labels and placeholders, a privacy reassurance line, error messages and a success message; a quote with the thank-you page copy (headline, next step, share line); and bullets on button placement and repetition.
